subject: Next steps & procurement timeline for AcmeCloud (post-demo)
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmecloud.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Great demo — next steps (procurement & timeline)

Marcus — thanks for the demo this morning. The team found the latency/cost breakouts and routing controls very compelling. A quick recap from our side and a few questions so we can kick off procurement: 

- High level ask: we want Redwood in a production pilot for search augmentation across 2 services (customer support + KB).
- Procurement path: our default is a PO via centralized finance, but small proofs sometimes go on a corporate card. Which approach is preferred for Redwood?
- Marketplace: we're evaluating purchases via AWS Marketplace (would simplify procurement). Do you support that? Any additional lead time?
- Security/compliance: security team will require your completed questionnaire and the standard SSO/SAML/KMS details.
- Legal: they will need an SOW and standard contract redlines.

Can you send a suggested mutual action plan (milestones & owners) and the SOW/security questionnaire so we can share with Legal/Security/Finance?

Thanks — I’ll loop in Jon Park (Procurement) once we have the docs.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Platform Engineering | AcmeCloud
sofia.ramos@acmecloud.com
+1 415-555-0189

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmecloud.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, elliot_price@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Great demo — next steps (procurement & timeline)

Hi Sofia — great to meet you and the team this morning. Appreciate the clear ask. Attaching our standard onboarding SOW (Redwood_Prod_Onboarding_SOW_v1.pdf) and a security questionnaire template (Acme_MSQC_Security_Questions.xlsx) to get Security and Legal started. 

Quick answers up front:
- PO vs Card: We support both. For pilots under $10k a card is common; for production pilots and enterprise engagements we recommend a PO (easier for invoicing and SLA/term alignment).
- Marketplace: We are available via AWS Marketplace, but that path typically adds ~2–3 weeks for procurement onboarding (depending on marketplace billing and vendor enrollment). We can do direct PO in parallel to avoid blocking the pilot.

Proposed mutual action plan / timeline (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week): Share SOW & security questionnaire (attached) — owner: Marcus/Redwood.
2) Week 1: Legal review of SOW & standard T&Cs — owner: Acme Legal (cc Jon).
3) Week 1–2: Security review — completed questionnaire, SSO/KMS details exchanged, optionally an architecture call — owner: Acme Security + Redwood Solutions Engineer (Elliot).
4) Week 2–3: Procurement/vendor onboarding, finance approval, PO issuance OR card setup — owner: Acme Procurement (Jon) / Finance.
5) Week 3–4: Contract signature (DocuSign) and onboarding kickoff (technical kick-off + staging access) — target go-live for pilot within 3–4 weeks.

If that timeline looks reasonable I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30-minute procurement sync (include Procurement, Legal, and Security). Also tagging Laura to propose pricing term options and any standard addendum for marketplaces.

Next steps for you: please confirm who will own Legal, Security, and Procurement on your side (names/emails) and whether you prefer PO vs card for this pilot.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood_Prod_Onboarding_SOW_v1.pdf (13KB)
Attachment: Acme_MSQC_Security_Questions.xlsx (22KB)

Cc: Jon Park <jon.park@acmecloud.com>

Subject: Re: Great demo — next steps (procurement & timeline)

Thanks Marcus — that timeline is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Legal: Sarah O’Neill (sarah.oneill@acmecloud.com) will lead SOW review. She typically needs 5–7 business days for an initial pass.
- Security: I’ll route the security questionnaire to our SecOps reviewers; they often ask for a 1:1 architecture call after seeing the filled questionnaire — suggested owner: Rajiv Mehra (rajiv.mehra@acmecloud.com).
- Procurement/Finance: Jon (cc’d) owns vendor onboarding and PO issuance. Jon — what are your timelines for vendor onboarding and PO creation? Also, do you require a vendor setup form?

On marketplace: we’d prefer AWS Marketplace if it doesn’t push our timeline past April. If you can do direct PO in parallel, that’s ideal.

DocuSign: legal prefers DocuSign for countersigning. Is that ok?

I’ll upload the PO template and vendor form once Jon confirms who will fill them out.

Best,
Sofia

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmecloud.com>
Cc: elliot_price@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Great demo — next steps (procurement & timeline)

Looping in a quick pricing/process note from Redwood side. Marcus — I sketched a slightly more granular MAP and some options for the commercial path.

Option A (PO — recommended for pilot > $10k):
- Timeline: 2–3 weeks for legal + security + procurement (parallel where possible).
- Commercial: Standard net-30 invoice on PO; addendum for AWS Marketplace not required.
- Notes: We will accept PO, send invoice after countersignature.

Option B (Card / low-dollar pilot):
- Timeline: 1 week to get card processed and sandbox access; pilot will be limited to $X/month until we finalize PO.

AWS Marketplace path:
- Adds ~2 weeks for marketplace vendor onboarding; if you want to go this route, we recommend proceeding with direct PO in parallel to avoid schedule slip.

Suggested detailed MAP (owners):
- Day 0: Marcus sends SOW + security questionnaire (done).
- Days 1–3: Acme Legal first review (Sarah).
- Days 3–7: SecOps completes questionnaire + architecture call (Rajiv) — owner: Elliot (Redwood Solutions Eng).
- Days 7–14: Procurement completes vendor setup + issues PO — owner: Jon (Acme).
- Day 14: Contract countersigned in DocuSign; finance processes first invoice — owner: Acme Finance / Redwood Ops.

Attachments: I’ve uploaded a filled guidance copy of the security questionnaire for your SecOps team to reference (Acme_MSQC_Security_Questions.xlsx). Note: marketplace invoicing may need a separate addendum — we can draft if you prefer.

Happy to join the procurement sync — propose Thu Mar 5 at 10am PT for a 30-minute call. Marcus — can you send the invite and include Jon, Sarah, and Rajiv?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Lead Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Attachment: Acme_MSQC_Security_Questions.xlsx (guidance copy)
